The [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] owned a '''safe house''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]]. [[Qiltakka]] and [[Ybann]] used this safe house to negotiate a treaty between the Cartel and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] when [[Darth Baras]]' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] interrupted the negotiations and killed the two [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice [[Girik]].<ref name="Disrupt Negotiations" />
